module.name: Zeus Voice Plane
module.changelog: *17.0.1* First release — the read-only voice-plane view, and the only way an entry reaches the FreePBX admin menu (the framework builds the menu from each installed module's module.xml `menuitems`; there is no user-defined menu store to write instead).
module.description:
A read-only view of the voice plane, inside the PBX that answers it: the routing plan the portal publishes (per-DID agent, provider, Capstone hand-off gate and interview workflow), what this PBX actually routes for each of those DIDs, and the channels that are live right now.
It is a window, never a writer. Routing is authored in the portal and written to FreePBX by the platform's own tools (pbx/ava_routes.py and Capstone's sync); this module has no POST handler and issues only GET requests, so there is no control here that can re-route a call, and two products cannot come to disagree about what owns a DID.
